item.title: Dog fouling on communal grass, 3rd August
item.description:
Number 40 has a visitor with a large dog. The dog has been fouling all over the communal grass for the past week. The owner refuses to pick it up and becomes abusive when asked to do so. He also abuses the dog and shouldn’t be allowed to keep it.

item.title: Abandoned green bin attracting tipping and vermin, 3rd August
item.description:
A green bin has been abandoned with waste overspilling and fly tipping surrounding it. Please arrange removal and clearance as this is a hazard in the public street and is encouraging more waste and attracting vermin. Thanks NOTE: THIS WAS REPORTED PREVIOUSLY VIA ref: 9868165 AND CLOSED WITH AN UNHELPFUL COMMENT SAYING THIS IS NOT ONE OF OUR STREETS AND TO REPORT TO THE CORRECT CREW. THIS IS IN THE GREENWICH BOROUGH AND THE COUNCIL NEEDS TO DIRECT THE ISSUE TO THE CORRECT TEAM. WE SHOULD NOT HAVE TO REPORT THIS AGAIN WHILE IT REMAINS AN UNRESOLVED HEALTH AND FIRE HAZARD.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Macbean Street, Woolwich
